title: A Survey on Multimodal Benchmarks: In the Era of Large AI Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not review any benchmarks that specifically measure aspects of faith or religion.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it focuses on the technical capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (understanding, reasoning, generation, application) and does not analyze social biases or specific knowledge domains like religion.
